criticism: The contract uses the current block timestamp as a dependency, which can be manipulated by miners to influence the outcome of certain functions.
The initial supply is set to a fixed value, which can be manipulated by miners to influence the total supply of the token.
The transferOwnership function does not have any access control measures, allowing any address to become the owner of the contract.
The transfer function does not have any access control measures, allowing any address to transfer tokens.
The transferFrom function does not have any access control measures, allowing any address to transfer tokens on behalf of others.
